test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No Improvement'.**

I take pride __to serve__ my country.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'in serving'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'in serving' **should be used instead of **'to serve'.**
 
• The noun '**pride**' is followed by a **preposition** '**in**'. And after the preposition verb is used in the '**ing**' form. 
 
• Hence, '**serving**' should be used. 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *I take pride **in serving **my country.*
